identity.standaloneProfile: Signed-permit bootstrap is bound to appId=essay-evaluator; browser state alone is never authority for a future protected school-server action.
identity.schoolProfile: Server-session enforcement remains deferred until approved school runtime is connected.
identity.rule: Client storage claims never authorize a future protected server-side action.

requestApiAi.controls: Four bounded AI Core operations; no provider tools, autonomous tool loop, or model-triggered application side effects.

egress.standalone: Explicit direct-gemini transport with session-scoped teacher key and no automatic fallback.
egress.school: Only school-gateway is allowed; local provider keys are forbidden and LIVE validation is mandatory when connected.
egress.feedback: Optional feedback delivery is teacher-configured, restricted to validated Google Apps Script exec endpoints, and requires explicit teacher confirmation.

files.currentBoundary: Teacher-controlled essay text, images and documents are untrusted inputs and remain subject to existing size/type/parsing/sanitisation controls.
files.serverBoundary: Server quarantine is not claimed and remains deferred.

dataLifecycle.classification: D2 educational content may contain student-related data; pseudonymisation is not anonymisation and sensitive student data must not be used to claim LIVE approval.
dataLifecycle.storage: Namespaced browser storage and PWA cache remain governed by the data manifest and suite-session cleanup.
dataLifecycle.retention: Standalone retention follows the data manifest and explicit end-work controls.
dataLifecycle.deletion: Client cleanup removes working data and credential remnants while preserving documented non-content preferences/security tombstones.

release.promotion: candidate -> P5 plus retained GARP 2.5.1 regressions and GARP 2.7 gates -> protected candidate-to-main PR -> exact release identity -> verified Pages deployment -> app-updated notification
release.publicAssurance: GitHub Pages is current standalone deployment; school-server LIVE remains NOT_TESTED.
release.rollback: Safe Promotion, exact release identity and prior verified releases remain rollback baseline.

inventory.changeRule: Any new AI operation, egress mode, provider tool, storage authority or release authority requires inventory and matching test updates.

securityHealth.localCi: GARP 2.7 contract, semantic policy, architecture, mutation and auto-patch gates run with retained GARP 2.5.1/P5 controls.
securityHealth.live: NOT_TESTED for school runtime until approved infrastructure supplies trusted runtime evidence.
securityHealth.failureMode: Harness errors, stale/mismatched evidence and missing controls never become PASS.

incident.current: Fail-closed access, bounded diagnostics, release evidence and Safe Promotion remain active.
incident.future: Central watchdog and infrastructure containment remain deferred.

recovery.current: Safe Promotion, release identity, deterministic lockfile inputs and client cleanup remain recovery baseline.
recovery.future: Server restore and live recovery drills remain NOT_TESTED.
